title: Overview
slide_intent: Ask editors to choose photographs that reveal a particular encounter. People can recognize context and individuality when a collection includes specific faces, settings and actions.
strategic_value: The organization can build a photographic identity from its own documentary work by selecting images that contain details of the people and places photographed.
demonstration: Four differently sized images sit on black: a person at night in a street, a smiling portrait, hands on a head, and a hand presenting a small white object.
practical_value: Compare candidate images by identifying a detail or moment each contributes to the story. Use the referenced media library to look for complementary views.

content_islands.name: Editorial guidance
content_islands.spec: Keep the section rail and overview in white type on black. Place the media-library reference beneath the text.

content_islands.name: Photo arrangement
content_islands.spec: Distribute four differently scaled photographs around the text. Keep the crop and proportions of each view distinct and use the black space to separate the moments.
